title: Forecast
description: Forecast of weekly cases for a geography and target week.

origin_week.description: Last week of data the forecast was allowed to use (the forecast date).

quantiles.description: Quantiles with strictly increasing levels and non-decreasing values; never empty.

run_count.description: Number of ensemble members behind the quantiles.

seed.description: Seed of the stochastic run that produced the ensemble.

ForecastQuantile.description: One quantile of a forecast predictive distribution.

value.description: Predicted weekly case count at that quantile (non-negative).

GeoId.description: Geography key: state FIPS (2 digits) or county FIPS (5 digits), zero-padded

MmwrWeek.description: An MMWR year and week number (`week` is `1..=52` or `1..=53`).

week.description: Week of the MMWR year; 1 to 52, or 53 in a 53-week year.

year.description: MMWR year (not always the calendar year of every day in the week).

Provenance.description: Where a number came from: the immutable snapshot, its source URL and when it was retrieved.

licence_id.description: Id of the source's licence or terms as listed in `SOURCES.md`.

sha256.description: Content address of the raw snapshot bytes.

source_id.description: Stable id of the source as listed in `SOURCES.md` (e.g. `cdc-measles-weekly`).

url.description: URL the snapshot was retrieved from.
